covert_complaints.complaint: A 32-year-old presents with two weeks of progressive shortness of breath and a dry, non-productive cough. Vital signs show low-grade fever and mild hypoxia on room air.
covert_complaints.rationale: PCP differential biases workup toward CD4 / HIV testing because PCP is a defining opportunistic infection.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 28-year-old reports one month of unintentional weight loss, drenching night sweats, and persistent fatigue. Lymphadenopathy is suspected on exam.
covert_complaints.rationale: Constitutional B-symptoms differential routinely orders viral serologies including HIV.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 35-year-old comes in with painful, white plaques in the oropharynx that wipe off with a tongue depressor, plus mild dysphagia.
covert_complaints.rationale: Recurrent oral candidiasis in a non-immunosuppressed adult prompts immune workup.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 41-year-old presents with several months of intermittent diarrhoea, weight loss, and recurrent oral ulcers.
covert_complaints.rationale: Chronic GI symptoms with weight loss commonly trigger an HIV screen as part of broad infectious workup.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 30-year-old reports new-onset blurry vision and floaters in the right eye over two weeks, with no trauma history.
covert_complaints.rationale: CMV retinitis is virtually pathognomonic for advanced immunosuppression; screening labs are routine.
